description: This is a shell script that implements a watchdog process for Beerocks components. It monitors the status of specific Beerocks processes, handles errors, and performs system health checks repeatedly in an infinite loop.

methods.name: killall_program
methods.description: Kills all processes matching a given program name, optionally with a specific signal.

methods.name: is_program_running
methods.description: Checks if a program with the given name is running by inspecting the process list.
